name: GKENT
recent: GKENT 于 2026 年 9 月 1 日完成收购 Techkem Group Sdn Bhd 76% 股权，后者旗下数家公司成为其子公司。公司于 2026 年 9 月 15 日召开第 75 届常年股东大会，所有 7 项普通决议案均获通过。此外，公司于 2026 年 11 月 10 日更换公司秘书。
notable: 完成收购 Techkem Group Sdn Bhd 76% 股权，后者旗下 Techkem Utilities、Techkem Chemicals 及 Techkem Resources 成为子公司。
第 75 届常年股东大会所有 7 项普通决议案获股东通过。
公司秘书 Teh Yong Fah 卸任，由新公司秘书接替。

ann.title: Change of Company Secretary - TEH YONG FAH
TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS

recent_en: GKENT completed the acquisition of a 76% equity interest in Techkem Group Sdn Bhd on 1 September 2026, with several of its subsidiaries becoming subsidiaries of the company. The company held its 75th Annual General Meeting on 15 September 2026, where all seven ordinary resolutions were passed. In addition, the company changed its company secretary on 10 November 2026.
notable_en: Completed the acquisition of a 76% equity interest in Techkem Group Sdn Bhd, with Techkem Utilities, Techkem Chemicals and Techkem Resources becoming subsidiaries.
All seven ordinary resolutions were passed by shareholders at the 75th Annual General Meeting.
Company secretary Teh Yong Fah was replaced by a new company secretary.
